author: Wayne Hamadi
description: Four Raix functions on Datacircle's open API, with no key: list the GTM APIs, the best plans of one API, a search of every plan and one provider's ranks. We benchmark all the GTM APIs and we put the results on our website: https://datacircle.dev

author: Kihaya Sugiura
description: The core of tilework: pure Ruby, no native extension, ships the :cpu backend as the conformance oracle for the tilework-metal / tilework-cuda / tilework-hip backend gems.

author: Kihaya Sugiura
description: The Metal backend gem for tilework: the native extension (ext/tilework/metal, Swift + a C ABI shim). Depends on the tilework core gem for Buffer/Kernel/DSL/Ops and the compat/metal.h dialect header.

author: Kihaya Sugiura
description: The CUDA backend gem for tilework: the native extension (ext/tilework/cuda, CUDA Driver API + NVRTC host C++). Depends on the tilework core gem for Buffer/Kernel/DSL/Ops and the compat/cuda.h dialect header.

author: Kihaya Sugiura
description: The HIP backend gem for tilework: HIP Runtime + HIPRTC native bridge.
